notes: People at a station for measuring (docs/tasks/humans/00-task-roadmap.md, 'Measuring on the user's hardware'): PRUDNIK (--game-root <OR_PSK_NEW> --route PRUDNIK) with its Open Rails timetable PSK_2026, Raszowa from 12:10:30: the people of 1156_R46421 (an EN57, arriving 12:11, leaving 12:12) waiting, seen from the platform 10 m out (raszowa-waiting, still) and from above (raszowa-above, still), then an EN57 door from 6 m while the simulation runs on 0.5 s a frame (raszowa-boarding: people getting off, then on, up the steps), and from the same place the run played for 110 s in real time, a paint and a frame log line a frame (raszowa-live: the last people getting on, the doors closing, the train leaving, those off walking away; a view's run plays before its camera moves, so it stands where the view before it stood). Editor lines hidden, the sky at noon. Measure each view at each core.rendering.humanQuality (0-3), OpenGL and QRhi, and once with core.content.people set to 2 (Never) as the baseline.
